content.title: Truth, Trust, and Testimony in a Time of Tension (2013)
content.author: Calvinism Advisory Committee, convened by Frank S. Page, president of the SBC Executive Committee · June 2013
content.role: Primary record · not a teaching authority
content.note: A nineteen-member advisory group of Calvinists and non-Calvinists, not an official Convention committee, whose report names the truths Southern Baptists hold in common under the Baptist Faith and Message, the points of tension, and the call to trust one another. For showing that Southern Baptists themselves count these differences as within the fellowship. Baptist Press printed the full text. Describe and cite; a short phrase at most.
content.read: Read in full on 2026-11-27 in The Alabama Baptist's printing of the report (Baptist Press refused automated access): its four parts, Truth, Tensions, Trust and Testimony. The articles cite 'Tensions', which names the points on which Calvinist and non-Calvinist Southern Baptists differ.
